records.name: DeepSeek Harness
records.one_liner: A complete agent platform whose loop, providers, persistence and UI are composable Cordis plugins.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Published Cordis modules can be mounted, but supported SDK launches dsh subprocess.
features_notes.durable_resume: Write-ahead log and synthetic crash repair; no automatic replay of incomplete external effects.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Write confinement, platform-dependent; shell network and reads remain available.
features_notes.ide: ACP enables IDE integration; product is not an IDE extension.

dims.loop: Replaceable ReactLoopAgent plugin; durable inbox and log-derived model requests.
dims.providers: DeepSeek-native path plus pi-ai adapter; vendor-specific cache/log extensions.
dims.tools: Registry and middleware; concurrency-safe calls overlap, exclusive tools form barriers.
dims.context: Logged prompt/tool changes, request projection, compaction, skills and instruction files.
dims.state: Append-only versioned log, write-ahead checkpoints and synthetic unknown-outcome repair; no durable work replay.
dims.safety: OS write confinement and approvals; read/network access remain broad; sdk-minimal uses full access.
dims.extensibility: Cordis lifecycle/events, YAML composition, bundles, MCP and npm plugins.
dims.multi_agent: Spawn/fork/continue delegates, workflows and experimental teams/worktrees.
dims.surfaces: Web/Electron product, headless CLI, subprocess TS/Python SDK and ACP.
dims.observability: OTel and replayable session projections; telemetry/log upload policy needs configuration.

key_insights: A complete agent platform whose loop, providers, persistence and UI are composable Cordis plugins.
Append-only versioned log, write-ahead checkpoints and synthetic unknown-outcome repair; no durable work replay.
OS write confinement and approvals; read/network access remain broad; sdk-minimal uses full access.

checked_claims: Root manifest version and MIT license
Architecture states loop and core services are replaceable Cordis plugins
Supported TS/Python SDKs launch dsh profiles
Model and top-level tool checkpoint gates fail before side effects
Crash repair distinguishes unstarted and unknown-outcome tools
bwrap profile leaves network shared and root readable
Seatbelt profile restricts writes with allow-default baseline
unresolved: No security audit or runtime sandbox testing performed.
Dynamic adoption/release counts were not independently checked.
verification.scope: Static inspection of selected high-impact claims. Not an exhaustive claim audit; no cloned code executed. Manifest/loop/recovery/safety boundaries prioritized.
